note: Alberta Parks campground in the Highwood Valley, 45 km southwest of Longview on Hwy 541 and 7 km south on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 940), run by Kananaskis Campground Services. Spacious treed sites; the hand pump is for putting out fires only, so bring drinking water. Sani-dump at Highwood House Day Use Area. Highway 40 over Highwood Pass is closed Dec 1 - June 15, so early-season access is from the south. A separate equestrian camp (sites 1-10) sits at the south end. --Claude

PIN (50.33235,-114.62703): at the campground entrance off the access road, ~130 m NNE of the loops' middle (~50.3312,-114.6271). The page's directions point 50.329310,-114.628517 is ~350 m SW (the equestrian/group end). No move needed.
SPLIT: the equestrian sites 1-10 are a separate horse camp (out of scope); nothing to split.

ROAD: the shop notes 'There is a seasonal road closure on the Highwood Pass section of Highway 40 from Dec 1-June 15; prior to June 15 access to the park is from the south only.' This is a highway seasonal closure, not a road problem with the campground; not a drop candidate.
